parameters.content:
## START HERE - Review & Testimonial Collector

**What it does:** Every morning it finds jobs completed N days ago, sends each customer a personalized AI-written 'how did we do?' email. A webhook catches their feedback: happy customers get a public-review ask, unhappy ones alert you privately - BEFORE they vent on Google.

**Setup (about 10 minutes):**
1. Make a Google Sheet with two tabs: `Jobs` and `Feedback` (exact columns on the sticky above the Sheets node).
2. Attach your **Google Sheets** credential to the 3 Sheets nodes and replace `YOUR_GOOGLE_SHEET_ID` in each (the long ID in your sheet's URL).
3. Attach your **Gmail** credential to the 3 email nodes.
4. Create a **Header Auth** credential called `Gemini API` (details on the AI sticky) and attach it to both AI nodes.
5. Open **Find Jobs Due** and **Normalize Reply** - edit the CONFIG blocks at the top: business name, owner email, public review link, feedback form URL, days to wait.
6. Point your feedback form (Tally, Fillout, your website form) at the webhook URL so it POSTs name / email / rating / message.
7. Activate the workflow.
8. Test: add a row to `Jobs` with Status = `completed` and a Completion Date 3+ days ago, then click 'Execute workflow' on the schedule trigger.

## Google Sheet layout

**`Jobs` tab** (read every morning) - header row:
`Job ID | Customer Name | Email | Job Type | Completion Date | Technician | Status | Review Requested`
- Status must be `completed` to qualify.
- `Review Requested` is stamped by this workflow. Leave it blank - it is what prevents double-sends.
- Completion Date: `YYYY-MM-DD` is safest.

**`Feedback` tab** (written by the webhook flow) - header row:
`Date | Name | Email | Rating | Message | Sentiment | Confidence | Summary | Testimonial Quote | Routed To`

## AI nodes - one credential for both

Both AI nodes POST to OpenAI's `/v1/chat/completions`.

1. Create credential type **Header Auth**, name it `Gemini API`:
   - Name: `Authorization`
   - Value: `Bearer sk-YOUR_KEY`
2. Attach it to **AI: Write Review Request** and **AI: Sentiment Sort**.

Works with ANY OpenAI-compatible provider (OpenRouter, Groq, local) - just swap the URL and model in the node.

The system prompts are the product. Tweak the tone rules freely, but keep the strict-JSON output lines intact - downstream code nodes parse them (with safe fallbacks).

## Feedback webhook (the reply catcher)

POST `https://YOUR-N8N-URL/webhook/review-feedback` with JSON or form fields:
`name`, `email`, `rating` (1-5), `message`. Point any form tool here.

- Invalid payloads (no rating AND no message) get a polite response and are dropped - no junk in your sheet.
- If the AI reply can't be parsed, the feedback routes to the OWNER alert on purpose. Nothing is ever lost.
- Neutral / mixed sentiment also goes to the owner - only clearly happy customers get the public-review ask.

Test with curl:
`curl -X POST https://YOUR-N8N-URL/webhook/review-feedback -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"name":"Sam Lee","email":"sam@example.com","rating":5,"message":"Fantastic job, spotless work!"}'`
